scenes.title: Modules and packages are a well-organised almirah
scenes.body: You don't throw every piece of clothing into one heap. Shirts go on one **shelf** (a module), the shelves sit in one **almirah** (a package), and you take out exactly what you need: **`from almirah import shirt`**.

scenes.title: Secrets are like your ATM PIN
scenes.body: You never **write your PIN on the card**. The card (your code) can be shared, copied, photographed. The PIN stays **with you**, outside the card. API keys belong in **environment variables**, not in code.

items.q: What is the difference between a module and a package?
items.a: A **module** is one `.py` file. A **package** is a folder of modules, usually with an `__init__.py`, imported by its folder name.
items.trap: Running a package's file directly (`python textkit/cleaning.py`) and wondering why its imports break. Use `python -m`.

items.a: `loads` parses a **string**; `load` reads from an open **file** object. Same pair for writing: `dumps` returns a string, `dump` writes to a file.
items.trap: Passing a file path string to `json.load`. It needs an open file, not a path.

items.q: An API key was committed to git. Is deleting the line enough?
items.a: No. It stays in the git **history**, and may already be copied. **Revoke** the key, create a new one, and keep it in an environment variable or `.env` that is git-ignored.
items.trap: Only rewriting history. The key must be treated as leaked.

captions.text: Asli AI projects kabhi ek file ke nahi hote.
Woh disk se prompts aur documents padhte hain, APIs ke saath JSON ka len den karte
hain, aur unhe secret API keys chahiye hoti hain, jo kabhi code mein nahi honi
chahiye.
Iss lesson mein yeh sab.
Iss lesson ke baad aap code ko modules aur packages mein baant paoge, aur import kar
paoge.
pathlib se files safely padhoge aur likhoge.
JSON aur Python ke beech convert karoge, aur kharab JSON handle karoge.
Aur configuration aur secrets ko environment variables mein rakhoge.
Pehle what: modules aur packages kya hain?
Ek almirah socho.
Aap saare kapde ek dher mein nahi phenkte.
Shirts ek shelf par, jeans doosri par.
Har shelf ek module hai, poori almirah ek package.
Aur zaroorat ho toh sirf woh nikaalte ho jo chahiye.
Ab dekhte hain Python code organise kaise hota hai.
Module bas ek Python file hai. cleaning dot py mein jo bhi define hai, functions,
classes, variables, sab kahin aur import ho sakta hai.
Package modules ka ek folder hai, jisme dunder init dot py naam ki file hoti hai.
Package import hote hi yeh file chalti hai, aur aksar sabse kaam ke naam aage export
karti hai.
Aapka program package ko naam se import karta hai, bilkul baaki cheezon ki tarah.
Modules ke do aur source hain.
Standard library, jo Python ke saath aati hai, jaise json, pathlib, aur os.
Aur third party packages jo pip se install hote hain, jaise httpx.
Yeh module hai. normalize text ko words mein todta hai, aur ek ek space se wapas
jodta hai.
Isse faaltu spaces hat jaate hain.
Aur word count normalize ko hi dobara use karta hai.
Chhote functions, jo ek doosre par khade hain.
Package ki init file dono functions import karti hai, taaki users unhe seedha
textkit par call kar sakein.
Aur dunder all batata hai ki kaunse naam public hain.
Import ke do tareeke. import textkit poora package laata hai, jise prefix ke saath
use karte ho.
Aur from textkit dot cleaning import word count, sirf ek naam laata hai.
main function kaam karta hai.
Output mein saaf kiya hua text, aur teen words.
Aakhri check Python ka ek idiom hai. dunder name equals dunder main tabhi true hota
hai jab file seedhe chalayi jaaye.
Koi doosri file isse import kare, toh main apne aap nahi chalta.
Agar apne hi package ke liye ModuleNotFoundError aaye, toh lagbhag hamesha aap galat
folder se Python chala rahe ho.
Python imports ko uss script ke folder se dhoondhna shuru karta hai jo aapne
chalayi.
Project root se chalao, aur packages ke liye python dash m.
Ab files.
Prompts, documents, logs, aur reports, sab files mein rehte hain.
Inke saath kaam karne ka modern tareeka hai pathlib.
Path object ek file ka path hai. write text file banata hai, ya overwrite karta hai.
Aur hamesha encoding equals utf eight do.
Windows par default encoding alag hota hai, aur AI ka text, jaise Hindi ya emoji,
basic English ke bahar ke characters se bhara hota hai.
read text poori file ek string mein deta hai, aur splitlines usse lines ki list bana
deta hai.
Zyaada control chahiye, toh file ko with block ke andar kholo.
Mode a ka matlab append, yaani end mein jodo.
Aur with guarantee deta hai ki file band hogi, chaahe beech mein error aa jaaye.
Aakhir mein lines ko number do, aur path se kuch sawaal poocho: file hai ya nahi,
uska suffix kya hai, aur kitne bytes.
Teen lines, aur thirty four bytes.
JSON data ke liye ek text format hai, aur AI engineering mein yeh har jagah hai.
Model APIs JSON bhejti aur leti hain, tool calls JSON mein describe hote hain, aur
logs aksar JSON hote hain.
Isse ek common courier ka dabba samjho, jise har system khol sakta hai.
JSON Python jaisa hi dikhta hai.
Curly braces mein objects, square brackets mein arrays, strings, numbers, true,
false, aur null.
Python ka json module inhe seedha map karta hai.
Objects dictionaries ban jaate hain, arrays lists, aur true, false, null ban jaate
hain capital True, False, aur None.
Lekin JSON Python se zyaada strict hai.
Strings ko double quotes chahiye, aur aakhri comma allowed nahi hai.
Hum ek normal Python dictionary se shuru karte hain.
json dot dumps, s matlab string, Python ko JSON text mein badalta hai. indent do se
padhne mein aasaan.
Output mein dekho: true aur null, chhote akshar mein.
Phir ise file mein save kiya.
json dot loads ulta kaam karta hai, JSON text ko wapas Python objects banata hai.
Isliye tokens phir se asli number hai: six hundred one.
Aur ok ek bool.
Aur galat JSON par JSONDecodeError aata hai.
Yahan aakhri comma ki wajah se.
Error column tak batata hai.
Language models kabhi kabhi thoda toota JSON dete hain, isliye yeh error aap bahut
handle karoge.
Ab environment variables.
Module zero mein humne yeh dekha tha, yahan Python ki taraf se.
ATM card socho.
PIN kabhi card par nahi likhte.
Card ki photo kheench sakti hai, card kho sakta hai.
PIN aapke paas rehta hai, card se alag.
API key bhi code mein nahi, environment variable mein rehti hai.
Ab why.
Pehla: secrets code se bahar rehte hain.
Source file mein likhi API key git history, screenshots, aur logs tak pahunch jaati
hai.
Doosra: code badle bina settings badal sakte ho.
Jaise laptop par ek model, aur production mein doosra.
Teesra: har platform inhe support karta hai.
Terminal, Docker, cloud, aur CI pipelines.
Module satrah tak aap inhe use karoge.
os module environment variables ko environ naam ke dictionary jaise object mein deta
hai. get, variable set na ho toh None deta hai, ya aapka chuna hua default.
Key missing ho toh saaf saaf bolo, baad mein ulajhne wale tareeke se fail mat ho.
Aur secret khud kabhi print mat karo.
Uski length print karna confirm karne ke liye kaafi hai.
Abhi kuch set nahi hai, toh script mana kar deti hai, aur default model use hota
hai.
Mac ya Linux par ek command ke liye variables aise set kar sakte ho.
Yeh fake key hai, sirf demo ke liye.
Key load hui, uski sirf length dikhi, aur model badal gaya.
Windows PowerShell mein pehle dollar env colon DEMO API KEY equals, aur value quotes
mein.
Aur roz ke kaam ke liye dot env file, jo Module zero mein dekhi thi.
Har baar variables type karna thakaau hai, isliye projects unhe dot env file mein
rakhte hain.
Commit hota hai template, dot env dot example, fake values ke saath, taaki doosron
ko pata ho kya set karna hai.
Asli dot env file mein aapki real keys hoti hain, aur woh dot gitignore mein listed
hai, toh git usse kabhi record nahi karta.
Project mein hum ek chhota loader likhenge jo dot env ko environment mein padhta
hai.
Aur asli environment variables hamesha file se jeette hain.
Interview corner.
Pehla question: module aur package mein kya farak hai?
Answer: module ek dot py file hai.
Package modules ka folder hai, aam taur par dunder init ke saath, jo folder ke naam
se import hota hai.
Trap: package ke andar ki file ko seedha chalana, aur phir sochna ki imports kyun
toot gaye. python dash m use karo.
Doosra: json load aur json loads mein farak?
Answer: loads ek string ko parse karta hai, load ek khuli file se padhta hai.
Likhne ke liye bhi yahi jodi: dumps string lautaata hai, dump file mein likhta hai.
Trap: json load ko file ka path dena.
Use khuli file chahiye, path nahi.
Teesra: ek API key git mein commit ho gayi.
Kya line delete karna kaafi hai?
Answer: nahi.
Woh git history mein rehti hai, aur shayad copy bhi ho chuki hai.
Key revoke karo, nayi banao, aur environment variable ya git ignored dot env mein
rakho.
Trap: sirf history saaf karna.
Key ko leaked hi maano.
Practice time.
Video pause karo, aur khud try karo.
Pehla: textkit mein char count function jodo, aur init file se export karo.
Doosra: teen messages ki list chat dot json mein save karo, aur wapas load karo.
Teesra: DEMO MAX TOKENS ko int ki tarah padho, default five hundred.
Dhyaan do: environment variables hamesha text hote hain.
Aur scenario: model aakhri comma wala JSON deta hai.
App crash na ho, iske liye aapka code kya karega?
Quick check.
Kaunsi call iss JSON text ko Python dictionary banati hai?
B, json dot loads. s matlab string. dumps ulta jaata hai, aur bina s wala load khuli
file se padhta hai.
Doosra question.
Asli API key kahan rehni chahiye?
C.
Environment variable mein, ya git ignored dot env mein. dot env dot example commit
hoti hai, isliye usme sirf fake values.
Recap.
Module ek file hai, aur package dunder init wala folder.
Har file ke liye pathlib, aur encoding utf eight.
json loads aur dumps se convert karo, aur JSONDecodeError pakdo.
Secrets environment variables mein, aur commit sirf example file.
Agle lesson mein type hints jodenge, HTTP par web APIs se baat karenge, aur dekhenge
ki async AI apps ko tez kyun banata hai.
Lesson chaar complete.
Ab aapka code files mein baanta hua hai, aur secrets surakshit hain.
